# Toggl

Toggl is a time tracking application that helps users monitor and manage their work hours efficiently.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/toggl/.

## Actions

- **Create Client**: Create a new client in a workspace.
- **Create Organization**: Create a new organization with a default workspace.
- **Create Project**: Create a new project in a workspace.
- **Create Tag**: Create a new tag in a workspace.
- **Create Time Entry**: Create a new time entry in the specified workspace.
- **Delete Tag**: Delete a tag from a workspace.
- **Delete Toggl Client**: Delete a client in toggl.
- **Get Client Details**: Retrieve details of a specific client.
- **Get Current Time Entry**: Retrieve the current running time entry for the authenticated user.
- **Get Organization Details**: Retrieve details of a specific organization by its id.
- **Get Organization Groups**: Retrieve list of groups in a specified organization.
- **Get Organization Users**: Retrieve all users in a toggl organization by organization id.
- **Get Project Details**: Retrieve details of a specific project.
- **Get Projects**: Retrieve a list of projects from a toggl workspace.
- **Get Tags**: Retrieve all tags in a toggl workspace.
- **Get Time Entries**: List the latest time entries for the authenticated user.
- **Get Time Entry**: Retrieve a specific time entry by its id.
- **Get User Clients**: Fetch the list of clients accessible by the authenticated user.
- **Get User Preferences**: Retrieve current user's preferences and alpha features.
- **Get User Projects**: Retrieve all projects for the authenticated user.
- **Get User Tags**: Retrieve tags associated with the current user.
- **Get User Tasks**: Retrieve tasks from projects in which the authenticated user is participating.
- **Get User Workspaces**: Retrieve all workspaces the authenticated user belongs to.
- **Get Workspace Details**: Retrieve details of a specific workspace.
- **Get Workspace Preferences**: Retrieve workspace preferences.
- **Get Workspace Users**: Retrieve all users in a toggl workspace by workspace id.
- **List Clients**: Retrieve a list of clients from a toggl workspace.
- **List Tasks**: List tasks in a workspace or within a specific project.
- **Stop Time Entry**: Stop a running time entry in a workspace.
- **Update Client**: Update details of a specific client.
- **Update Tag**: Update an existing tag in a specified workspace.
